scope: Isolated synthetic staging, all retained commerce records; feedback window 24 hours.
limitations: Synthetic rehearsals are not customer conversion evidence.
Cart deletion can remove proposal history.
Orders may occur before proposal application; only proposal creation timestamps exist.

goal_completion_proxy.definition: Distinct tasks with an applied proposal / recorded tasks. Does not measure semantic goal completion.

proposal_application.definition: Applied / created proposals, including revisions and blocked proposals; application is the recorded approval proxy.

checkout_continuation_association.definition: Applied carts with a later quote / applied carts. Proposal creation time is used because application time is not recorded.

conversion_association.definition: Applied carts linked to orders through quotes / applied carts; observational association, not causal AI attribution.

cancellation_rate.definition: Currently cancelled / all recorded orders in this isolated store.

repeat_purchase.definition: Customers with multiple recorded orders / customers with an order; no maturity window.

satisfaction.definition: Helpful votes / received binary votes in the existing tenant-scoped 24-hour assistant report.

feedback_coverage.definition: Votes / recorded assistant turns in 24 hours; nonresponders are not assumed satisfied.

semantic_goal_completion.reason: No goal outcome labels; completed turns are not completed goals.

margin_aware_value.reason: No authoritative item cost snapshot is joined to assistant outcomes.

return_rate.reason: Refund records do not establish a returns denominator or a return event.

support_deflection.reason: No matched support counterfactual and resolution observation.

incremental_conversion_lift.reason: No randomized assignment, control group or stable exposure-to-order attribution.
